title: vLLM-Omni streaming audio, deployment and measurement boundaries
summary: Resolve supported stage placement and backend settings, then measure first media packet and chunk continuity alongside complete output and quality.

zh-CN.title: vLLM-Omni 流式音频、部署与测量边界
zh-CN.summary: 解析受支持的阶段部署和后端配置，将首媒体包、分块连续性与完整输出及质量一起测量。

conditions: Start from the selected model supported default with compatible dependency versions.
Record the effective configuration after model/platform/YAML/CLI resolution and confirm active placement/backend in logs.

recommendations: Establish a fixed short request before concurrency and separate compile/warmup, queueing, inference, transport and output encoding.
Use first media packet, chunk gaps, audio duration/continuity, errors and quality to diagnose stage bottlenecks before increasing resources.
validation_plan: Compare complete streamed/non-streamed output, audio/text agreement and repeated-request cleanup on target hardware.
Run matched repeated workloads with controlled warmup/cache state and retain errors and quality regressions.
limitations: Text token throughput alone does not describe audio latency, continuity or media quality.
Parser acceptance does not certify the selected stage/runtime/backend combination.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
